no_organization.description: No version of the organization is in effect today, or the person is not one of the people of the version in effect: the organization holds everyone's addresses, and is read by its people alone

unchosen.description: No kind of request the server holds chooses from the master

limited.description: Too many comments: the server limits how soon a person comments on a ticket again, and how many comments a ticket holds, and this one is not taken (no refusal of the machine, and the ticket is as it was). When it came too soon, `Retry-After` says in how many seconds it may be sent again, with the same idempotency key; when the ticket holds as many comments as the server takes, there is no `Retry-After`, for waiting does not change that

Retry-After.description: In how many seconds the comment may be sent again; only when it came too soon after the person's last comment on the ticket

unsigned.description: No one is signed in: the server authenticates no person for the call

oversized.description: The body is larger than the server takes

not_json.description: The body is not sent as `application/json`: the call's `Content-Type` says another type, or none

failed.description: The server failed, and says no more here (its log says how). Whether an operation that moves a ticket was done is not said: the same call is sent again with the same idempotency key, which answers what the first did if it was done
